en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large classical triumphal arch standing on a dirt road, with several uniformed men and townspeople nearby. Low, one‑ and two‑story buildings with hipped roofs line the right side, suggesting a small Russian townscape. Printed text in Russian and French/Latin letters appears in the upper left corner identifying the view as an Omsk city gate associated with the fortress.
